fields.v: Evaluates; secondary: Proposes an approach — repository-mining study of 3,387 instruction files in 1,000 AIDev GitHub repositories (adoption, cross-format consistency, maintenance), from which an evidence-based 16-category template for agent instruction files (10 Required, 4 Gap, 2 Recommended) with a maintenance protocol is derived; also introduces the AGIT-Instruct benchmark for instruction-file generation; exploratory generation experiment (with vs without template; four template-guided configurations)
fields.quote: Based on the results of these research questions, we derive an evidencebased template containing 16 categories organized into ten Required, four Gap, and two Recommended categories.
fields.why: The record scores Q13 (which applies only to conceptual studies and studies that propose an approach), but the nature lists only 'Proposes an evaluation method' as secondary; the template is a proposed authoring approach, so either the nature should name 'Proposes an approach' or Q13 should be N/A.
fields.doubt: O Q13 está pontuado, mas a natureza não diz 'Proposes an approach' (só 'Proposes an evaluation method', o benchmark). O template de 16 categorias é uma abordagem proposta (pág. 4 e 17). Decide: ou mudas a secundária para 'Proposes an approach' (e mencionas o benchmark no detalhe), ou pões Q13 em N/A.
